events.output:
Here is a detailed 14-day beginner machine learning learning plan that covers Python, data preprocessing, supervised learning, model evaluation, and basic unsupervised learning, with both theory and practical exercises. The final two days are reserved for revision and a small project.

---

### **Day 1-2: Introduction to Python for Machine Learning**
**Theory:**
- Learn the basics of Python programming: variables, data types, loops, conditionals, and functions.
- Understand Python libraries commonly used in machine learning (NumPy, Pandas, Matplotlib).
- Resources: [Learn Python Tutorial](https://www.learnpython.org/), [Python Tutorial for Beginners](https://www.w3schools.com/python/)

**Practical:**
- Write simple Python scripts to calculate basic statistics (mean, median, mode).
- Practice reading and writing data to/from CSV files using Pandas.

---

### **Day 3-4: Data Preprocessing**
**Theory:**
- Learn about data cleaning, handling missing values, and feature scaling.
- Understand the importance of feature engineering and encoding categorical variables.
- Resources: [Data Preprocessing in Machine Learning](https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/machine-learning/machine-learning-tutorial/)

**Practical:**
- Use Pandas to load a dataset, handle missing values, and scale features.
- Encode categorical variables using one-hot encoding.
- Dataset: [Titanic Dataset](https://www.kaggle.com/c/titanic/data) (available on Kaggle)

---

### **Day 5-6: Introduction to Supervised Learning**
**Theory:**
- Learn about supervised learning, including classification and regression.
- Understand key algorithms: Linear Regression, Logistic Regression, Decision Trees, and k-Nearest Neighbors (k-NN).
- Resources: [Machine Learning Tutorial - GeeksforGeeks](https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/machine-learning/machine-learning-tutorial/)

**Practical:**
- Implement Linear Regression and Logistic Regression using scikit-learn.
- Practice predicting house prices (regression) and classifying iris flowers (classification).
- Dataset: [Iris Dataset](https://archive.ics.uci.edu/ml/datasets/iris), [Boston Housing Dataset](https://archive.ics.uci.edu/ml/datasets/Boston+Housing)

---

### **Day 7-8: Model Evaluation**
**Theory:**
- Learn about model evaluation metrics: accuracy, precision, recall, F1-score, and mean squared error (MSE).
- Understand cross-validation and train-test splits.
- Resources: [Model Evaluation in Machine Learning](https://scikit-learn.org/stable/modules/model_evaluation.html)

**Practical:**
- Evaluate your models from Day 5-6 using the metrics mentioned above.
- Split your dataset into training and testing sets and use cross-validation.
- Dataset: [Wine Quality Dataset](https://archive.ics.uci.edu/ml/datasets/wine+quality)

---

### **Day 9-10: Basic Unsupervised Learning**
**Theory:**
- Learn about unsupervised learning, including clustering and dimensionality reduction.
- Understand key algorithms: k-Means Clustering and Principal Component Analysis (PCA).
- Resources: [Unsupervised Learning in Machine Learning](https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/unsupervised-learning/)

**Practical:**
- Apply k-Means clustering to group similar data points in a dataset.
- Use PCA to reduce the dimensionality of a dataset.
- Dataset: [Iris Dataset](https://archive.ics.uci.edu/ml/datasets/iris) (for clustering)

---

### **Day 11-12: Deep Dive into Supervised Learning Models**
**Theory:**
- Learn about more advanced supervised learning models: Support Vector Machines (SVM), Random Forest, and Gradient Boosting.
- Understand hyperparameter tuning and model selection.

**Practical:**
- Implement SVM, Random Forest, and Gradient Boosting using scikit-learn.
- Compare the performance of these models on your datasets.
- Dataset: [Breast Cancer Dataset](https://archive.ics.uci.edu/ml/datasets/Breast+Cancer+Wisconsin+Diagnostic)

---

### **Day 13: Revision and Concept Consolidation**
**Theory:**
- Review all the concepts covered in the previous days.
- Focus on areas where you feel less confident and revisit the theory and practical exercises.

**Practical:**
- Revisit your previous exercises and try to improve your models.
- Experiment with different datasets and algorithms.

---

### **Day 14: Small Project**
**Project:**
- Choose a dataset from the list below and build a complete machine learning pipeline:
  - Load and preprocess the data.
  - Train a supervised or unsupervised learning model.
  - Evaluate the model and interpret the results.
- Example Projects:
  - Predict customer churn using the [Telecom Churn Dataset](https://www.kaggle.com/blastchar/telco-customer-churn).
  - Cluster customer segments using the [Customer Segmentation Dataset](https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/imakash3011/customer-segmentation).
  - Predict house prices using the [Boston Housing Dataset](https://archive.ics.uci.edu/ml/datasets/Boston+Housing).

---

### **Resources for Further Learning:**
- **Free Interactive Courses:** [Best Free Machine Learning Courses for Beginners](https://freeacademy.ai/blog/best-free-machine-learning-courses-beginners-2026)
- **Beginner-Friendly Datasets:** [Famous Machine Learning Datasets](https://medium.com/data-science-bootcamp/famous-machine-learning-datasets-you-need-to-know-dd031bf74dd)
- **Practice Projects:** [Beginner-Friendly ML Projects](https://github.com/poojajalwal002-tech/ml-beginner-project)

---

This plan ensures that you cover all the required topics, include both theory and practical exercises, and reserve the final two days for revision and a small project.
